skills.name: Search Verified Scientific Claims
skills.description: Search citation.is for verified scientific claims from structural biology, salmon biotechnology, genomics, and related life-science domains. Each claim is cross-referenced against PDB, UniProt, NCBI, and PubMed.

query.description: Free-text search query for claims, proteins, methods, or organisms

vertical.description: Domain filter: structural_biology, salmon_biotech, genomics, clinical_trials, nutrition

verdict.description: Filter by verdict: supported, refuted, inconclusive

skills.name: Verify a Scientific Claim
skills.description: Submit a scientific claim text to the citation.is verification pipeline. Returns a verdict (supported/refuted/inconclusive), confidence score, and evidence references from authoritative databases.
